## Scope

- Linked issue:
- Milestone:
- What changed and why:

## Verification

- [ ] `python -m ruff check .`
- [ ] `python -m pytest -v`
- [ ] New behavior has a RED/GREEN regression test, or this PR changes documentation only.
- [ ] `STATUS.md` reflects material project-state changes.

## Research integrity

- [ ] Raw artifacts remain authoritative; derived reports can be regenerated.
- [ ] Public files contain no private paths, usernames, raw GPU UUIDs, or secrets.
- [ ] Energy and cost claims use the declared measurement boundary.
- [ ] Any schema or methodology change has review from the other author.
- [ ] Hardware-dependent claims include the actual GPU, driver, runtime, model digest, and config.
